title: How do I resolve conflicting thermocouple counts in a pit-furnace proposal?
summary: “Three thermocouples per zone” is not automatically the delivery quantity for the whole furnace. Suneng's pit furnace proposal specifies two control zones and describes three probes per zone in detail, but its purchased-parts table lists only two duplex and one single-element thermocouple. The recorder is also described as both 12-channel and 6-channel. Reconcile per-zone quantities, whole-furnace totals and recording duties before confirming locations and wiring. Do not assume six probes or choose either channel count without clarification.
